WITH first_version AS (
    SELECT member_id, join_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS version_no
    FROM dim_member
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS members_joined
FROM first_version
WHERE version_no = 1
  AND join_date = '2026-10-03'
